text:
mike_sales: Quick heads-up — Aurelia POC streaming is dropping mid-response. Client sees JSON parse errors when long responses stream. Happening on iOS webview + desktop.

anita: Can you share client SDK logs and any proxy/runtime logs you have? Any 429s or rate-limit signs?

mike_sales: Client error: ```Error: Unexpected end of JSON input at position 432```
Proxy/runtime snippet: ```upstream: EOF before end of response; connection reset by peer```
No 429s reported. Customer says disconnect ~10-15s into stream.

sam: Is this flow using prefix/KV caching or long-lived kv sessions? If the KV cache evicts mid-stream it can close the connection unexpectedly.

liam: Also check chunk boundary handling — multibyte UTF-8 can be cut if chunker splits inside a codepoint. Quick workaround: bump streaming buffer to 64k and ensure keep-alive headers are present.

nora_support: On webviews we often see partial bytes cause the SSE parser to throw. If you can paste a raw payload sample that would help.

mike_sales: Raw payload (cut): ```data: {"id":"msg_123","text":"Welcome to Aurelia — we\u00E9"``` (stream truncated right after \u00E9)

sam: That looks like a UTF-8 multi-byte boundary cut. Runtime is returning chunk boundary mid-codepoint. We'll prioritize a boundary-safe chunker.

anita: From infra side I pulled their tenant metrics: a spike in keepalive timeouts at ~2026-03-18T14:12Z. Gateway closed TCP with RST after 30s for several connections. I'm going to increase idle timeout for their dedicated pool to 90s as a mitigation.

liam: Short-term client-side mitigation: use a streaming JSON parser that tolerates incomplete frames and retries on parser failure, or buffer until `\n\n` (SSE event delimiter). We can also add `retry` hint in SSE but that won't help broken codepoints.

nora_support: Also check for gzip + streaming combo. We had a bug where `Content-Length` wasn't set for gzipped streamed events and some webviews aborted when they couldn't determine content length.

mike_sales: Customer asked if increasing keepalive will change pricing. Any impact?

nora_support: Small impact — longer idle ties up a connection slot; on Dedicated it slightly increases reserved concurrency usage. We can set this per-tenant and monitor. Finance/backline: negligible for short-term trial.

sam: Immediate server-side workaround: enable chunk-alignment mode for this tenant (`X-Redwood-Chunk-Safe: true`) — runtime will align on UTF-8 boundaries and avoid mid-codepoint cuts. I'll flip it now for Aurelia.

deploy-bot: deploy#canary - canary job started for runtime/chunk-alignment

deploy-bot: deploy#canary - success (staging canary healthy)

liam: Canary includes a small change to streaming emitter — it buffers up to 4KB to ensure boundary-safe flushes. If stable we'll push to canary in the dedicated pool next. ETA ~2-3h.

anita: I've applied the idle timeout change and we're monitoring. Also opening a follow-up to fix gzip/content-length behavior in the proxy.

mike_sales: Great — customer agreed to test the canary. I'll run the session with them this afternoon and report results.

sam: If the canary doesn't clear it, we'll collect a pcap of the TLS session (customer-approved) to inspect raw bytes.

mike_sales: Thanks everyone — looping customer in now. Will update thread after they test. :thumbsup:
